svg.title: alphaBB animation
svg.text: f(x) + (α/2)(x − l)(x − u) is convex when α ≥ max(0, −min f″) (f″ from interval jax.grad(jax.grad))
αBB: whole functions use an interval Hessian; α per variable by scaled Gershgorin
1 · raise α: the added quadratic is ≤ 0 on the box, so the curve stays below f
2 · at α = −min f″ the curvature is nonnegative everywhere: a convex underestimator
3 · on half boxes the gap is 4× smaller: αBB takes over deep in the tree
